description: 液化石油ガスメーター立入検査(検査成績) [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 船橋市. 適正な計量の実施を確保するため、商店、工場及び病院等で取引や証明に使用している計量器を対象に定期検査を実施しています。 また、取引における計量の適正化を図るため、商店や工場及び事業所等への立入検査を行っています。 本データは、液化石油ガスメーター立入検査（検査成績）の実績を掲載しました。 本検査は4年に一度実施するものです。. Coverage: 船橋市. The portal files it under the publisher 船橋市. Its tags are 経済. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-02-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
